_help: One entry per node. To add a node, copy an entry and change it. status: available | soon. platform: meshtastic | meshcore. flash: esp (browser flasher, ESP32 boards) | uf2 (nRF52 boards: download and drag onto the drive). beta: true shows a Beta label; set it to false once that node's firmware is stable. The 'id' must match the firmware folder name the release builds (site/firmware/<id>/).
